displayName: Password-Protected Archive Staging for Data Exfiltration

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName in~ ("7z.exe", "7za.exe", "rar.exe", "winrar.exe", "7z")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (" -p", " -hp", " -v")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("\\temp\\", "\\programdata\\", "\\public\\", "/tmp/", "/dev/shm/")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

alertTemplate.title: Password-Protected Archive Staging for Data Exfiltration
alertTemplate.description: Detects creation of password-protected or split archives via 7-Zip, WinRAR or tar inside temporary or staging folders, a common pre-exfiltration step in state-linked intrusions. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405. Advisories: acsc-2026-10-09-chinese-state-linked-automated-tools.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Review the archived paths and check subsequent outbound network transfers from the host for signs of data exfiltration (ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405; Advisories: acsc-2026-10-09-chinese-state-linked-automated-tools).
